guides.title: Shattrath: Choose the Aldor or the Scryers
guides.summary: Every character entering Shattrath City is asked to pick a side between the Aldor and the Scryers. The short introduction from the Haggard War Veteran leads to A'dal and Khadgar, whose City of Light tour ends with the two Allegiance quests. The choice sets your starting standing with both factions and decides which quartermaster, inscriptions and later Netherwing and Sunwell quests you will see.
guides.unlocks: Friendly standing with your chosen Shattrath faction (3500 reputation), access to its rise, quartermaster and repeatable turn-ins, and half-value spillover reputation with the Sha'tar up to the top of Friendly.

phase.notes: Available from TBC launch (Anniversary Phase 1, 5 February 2026). Never removed. Draenei start Friendly with the Aldor and Blood Elves start Friendly with the Scryers but can still choose either side through these quests.

steps.title: Speak with A'dal in the Terrace of Light
steps.detail: A Haggard War Veteran stands at each entrance to Shattrath City (south-east gate 72.7, 55.2; also 61.8, 9.9 and 77.2, 43.4) and offers A'dal from level 60. Walk into the Terrace of Light and speak with the naaru A'dal at its centre. The quest pays 10 Sha'tar reputation and opens City of Light.

steps.title: Follow Khadgar's servant on the City of Light tour
steps.detail: Khadgar stands beside A'dal. Accept City of Light and follow his servant as it walks the whole city, stopping at Lower City, the Aldor Rise and the Scryer's Tier while telling Shattrath's story. The tour takes several minutes and cannot be sped up; stay close to the servant or it waits for you. Return to Khadgar when the credit City of Light appears in your log. This quest is also a hard prerequisite for the Netherwing quest Kill Them All! much later.

steps.title: Pledge allegiance to the Aldor or the Scryers
steps.questName: Allegiance to the Aldor / Allegiance to the Scryers
steps.detail: After City of Light Khadgar offers both Allegiance to the Aldor (10551) and Allegiance to the Scryers (10552); accepting and completing one locks out the other. Each gives 3500 reputation with the chosen faction, putting you at Friendly, and makes the other side hostile. The Aldor favour priests, paladins and holy-themed inscriptions and sit on the Aldor Rise in the north-west; the Scryers favour blood elf lore and arcane inscriptions and sit on the Scryer's Tier in the south-east. Both sides turn in the same marks later (Marks of Kil'jaeden or Sargeras and Fel Armaments for the Aldor; Firewing or Sunfury Signets and Arcane Tomes for the Scryers). The choice can be reversed later only by grinding the other side back to Neutral through repeatable turn-ins in Lower City (Sha'nir 18597 at 64.5, 15.1 for the Aldor; Arcanist Adyria 18596 at 55.0, 22.5 for the Scryers), which wipes the first faction's progress.
steps.detectedBy: Quest 10551 or 10552 flagged complete; equivalently faction 932 or 934 is at least Friendly (standingID 5) while the other is Hostile.

steps.title: Report to Ishanah or Voren'thal the Seer

turnIn.name: Ishanah (Aldor) or Voren'thal the Seer (Scryers, npc 18530 at 42.8, 91.7)

steps.detail: Khadgar immediately follows up with a breadcrumb to your new faction's leader: Ishanah (10554) in the Shrine of Unending Light on the Aldor Rise at 24.0, 29.7, or Voren'thal the Seer (10553) in the Seer's Library on the Scryer's Tier at 42.8, 91.7. Turning it in pays 10 reputation with your faction and 5 with the Sha'tar and introduces the first real Aldor or Scryer quests in Shattrath, Netherstorm and Shadowmoon Valley.

guides.notes: Faction ids: The Aldor 932, The Scryers 934, The Sha'tar 935 (AtlasLoot and Questie reputation rewards agree). Sha'tar spillover, confirmed facts only: Aldor and Scryer quests, including the repeatable turn-ins, also pay the Sha'tar at half value (Allegiance to the Scryers = 3500 Scryers and 1750 Sha'tar; ten Marks of Kil'jaeden or Sargeras = 250 Aldor and 125 Sha'tar; Voren'thal's Visions = 250 Scryers, -275 Aldor, 125 Sha'tar). The spillover stops at 5999/6000 Friendly with the Sha'tar, so it never pushes you into Honored; Honored and beyond need Sha'tar quests or Tempest Keep dungeon runs (Mechanar, Botanica, Arcatraz). Questie's quest rows list only the direct reward (932 or 934, 3500); the Sha'tar gain is a server-side faction link, so the addon should read it from the player's actual standing rather than from a quest table. Reputation gained with one Shattrath faction costs 10 percent more with the other. The A'dal quest has a level 60 minimum in Questie.

guides.title: Flying: Expert and Artisan Riding
guides.summary: Outland flight is bought in two steps from the riding trainers in Shadowmoon Valley at level 70. Expert Riding (225) and a 60 percent mount open the sky; Artisan Riding (300) and a 280 percent mount are the real investment at roughly 5200 gold. The Netherwing, Skyguard and Ogri'la daily hubs all assume you can fly, and Netherwing Ledge refuses you without Artisan Riding.
guides.unlocks: Riding skill 300 and an epic flying mount, which satisfy the Blood Oath of the Netherwing requirement, the Skyguard Skettis quests (225) and let you reach the Ogri'la plateau and Netherwing Ledge.

phase.notes: Available from TBC launch (Anniversary Phase 1). Costs are never discounted by reputation in TBC Classic. Druids learn Flight Form at 68 instead of Expert Riding; Swift Flight Form (Phase 2) still requires Artisan Riding.

steps.title: Reach level 70
steps.detail: Both flying ranks require level 70. Journeyman Riding (150) is also a prerequisite for Expert Riding, so finish your 60 percent ground mount training first. Save gold while levelling: Expert Riding plus a mount is 900 gold and Artisan Riding plus an epic mount is 5200 gold.

steps.title: Take Nutral's breadcrumb to the riding trainer

turnIn.name: Ilsa Blusterbrew (Alliance) or Olrokk (Horde, npc 20500 at 29.3, 29.3)

steps.detail: Nutral, the flight master on the Terrace of Light in Shattrath, hands out Learning to Fly at level 70, pointing Alliance players to Ilsa Blusterbrew at Wildhammer Stronghold and Horde players to Olrokk at Shadowmoon Village. It is only a signpost and gives no riding skill; skip it if you already know where the trainers are.

steps.title: Train Expert Riding (225) for 800 gold

giver.name: Ilsa Blusterbrew (Alliance) or Olrokk (Horde, npc 20500 at 29.3, 29.3)

steps.detail: Ilsa Blusterbrew (Riding Trainer, Wildhammer Stronghold 37.5, 56.3) teaches Alliance; Olrokk (Shadowmoon Village 29.3, 29.3) teaches Horde. Expert Riding costs 800 gold and grants 60 percent flight speed in Outland. Reputation does not reduce the price in TBC Classic. Druids get the same effect from Flight Form at level 68 for about 8 gold.
steps.detectedBy: Riding skill line 762 at rank 225 or higher, or spell 34090 known (druids: Flight Form known).

steps.title: Buy a 60 percent flying mount for 100 gold

giver.name: Brunn Flamebeard (Alliance) or Dama Wildmane (Horde, npc 20494 at 29.1, 29.5)

steps.detail: Brunn Flamebeard, Gryphon Keeper at Wildhammer Stronghold (37.6, 56.0), sells the Golden, Ebon and Snowy Gryphons; Dama Wildmane, Windrider Keeper at Shadowmoon Village (29.1, 29.5), sells the Tawny, Blue and Green Windriders. Each costs 100 gold. Any one of them is enough for Skettis, the Barrier Hills, Netherwing Fields and the Ogri'la plateau; only Netherwing Ledge's Blood Oath insists on the 300 skill.
steps.detectedBy: Any of the listed mount items in bags (TBC has no mount journal), or Expert Riding known and the player seen flying.

steps.title: Train Artisan Riding (300) for 5000 gold

giver.name: Ilsa Blusterbrew (Alliance) or Olrokk (Horde, npc 20500 at 29.3, 29.3)

steps.detail: The same two trainers teach Artisan Riding for 5000 gold once you have Expert Riding and are level 70. It raises flight speed to 280 percent and is the single requirement that Blood Oath of the Netherwing checks. No faction discount applies. Budget for the mount too, since the skill alone does not change your 60 percent mount.
steps.detectedBy: Riding skill line 762 at rank 300, or spell 34091 known.

steps.title: Buy a 280 percent flying mount for 200 gold

giver.name: Brunn Flamebeard (Alliance) or Dama Wildmane (Horde, npc 20494 at 29.1, 29.5)

steps.detail: Brunn Flamebeard sells the Swift Blue, Red, Green and Purple Gryphons; Dama Wildmane sells the Swift Red, Green, Yellow and Purple Windriders. Each is 200 gold. Later alternatives at the same speed are the Netherwing drakes (one free from Barthamus at Netherwing Exalted, the rest from Drake Dealer Hurlunk), the Skyguard nether rays (160 gold at Skyguard Exalted from Grella) and the Cenarion War Hippogryph.
steps.detectedBy: Any of the listed mount items in bags, or a Netherwing drake or nether ray reins item in bags.

guides.notes: All four riding spells (33388 Apprentice 75, 33391 Journeyman 150, 34090 Expert 225, 34091 Artisan 300) carry the plain name 'Riding' in the Anniversary tooltip data; 34092 Expert Riding and 34093 Artisan Riding are the trainer-side spells. Skill line 762 is Riding; Questie records Blood Oath of the Netherwing as requiredSkill 762 at 300 and every Skettis Skyguard quest as 762 at 225. All item names confirmed via the tooltip endpoint: Golden Gryphon 25470, Ebon Gryphon 25471, Snowy Gryphon 25472, Swift Blue Gryphon 25473, Swift Red Gryphon 25527, Swift Green Gryphon 25528, Swift Purple Gryphon 25529, Tawny Windrider 25474, Blue Windrider 25475, Green Windrider 25476, Swift Red Windrider 25477, Swift Green Windrider 25531, Swift Yellow Windrider 25532, Swift Purple Windrider 25533. Hargen Bronzewing and Wind Rider Jahubo (the Hellfire trainers) do not exist in the TBC Questie database; they were added in Wrath, so the Shadowmoon Valley trainers are the only ones.

guides.title: Ogri'la: the Blade's Edge ogre plateau
guides.summary: Mog'dorg the Wizened, atop the tower at the Circle of Blood, sends you after four of Gruul's sons and the warlock Vim'gol before Skulloc Soulgrinder can be destroyed. Only then does he point you to Chu'a'lor at Ogri'la, a plateau in western Blade's Edge reachable only by flying, where The Crystals opens the Apexis relic game, the Skyguard Outpost and four daily quests. Ogri'la reputation is earned almost entirely through those dailies, with Banish the Demons added at Honored.
guides.unlocks: Access to the Ogri'la and Skyguard Outpost daily quests, Apexis Shard and Crystal vendors (Jho'nass) at every standing, Sha'tari Skyguard reputation from the shared dailies, and Exalted gear and tabard.

phase.notes: Added in original patch 2.1; on Anniversary realms it arrived with Phase 2 (Overlords of Outland, 14 May 2026) and is never removed. Every quest requires level 70. Reaching the plateau needs a flying mount; Honored with the Sha'tari Skyguard later unlocks a Skyguard flight between Blackwind Landing and Ogri'la.

steps.title: Hear V'eru's call and find Grok in Lower City
steps.detail: The naaru V'eru in the Terrace of Light offers Speak with the Ogre at level 70. Grok, an ogre in the eastern Lower City near the Scryer's Tier lift, takes it and hands out Mog'dorg the Wizened. This is only a breadcrumb.

steps.title: Meet Mog'dorg atop the Circle of Blood tower
steps.detail: Fly to the Circle of Blood arena in central Blade's Edge and land on top of the stone tower at 55.5, 44.9, where Mog'dorg the Wizened waits. Three breadcrumbs lead here and any one of them opens his chain: Mog'dorg the Wizened from Grok (10983), the same-named quest from the ogre Chort beside the tower (10989), or The Trouble Below from Chu'a'lor if you fly straight to Ogri'la first (11057).
steps.detectedBy: Any of quests 10983, 10989 or 11057 flagged complete.

steps.title: Take Grulloc's Dragon Skull (group)
steps.detail: Mog'dorg hands out Grulloc Has Two Skulls, Maggoc's Treasure Chest and Even Gronn Have Standards together; do them in any order. Grulloc, Son of Gruul, paces the valley east of the Circle of Blood around 60.9, 47.6 and is a five-player elite gronn. Kill him and loot Grulloc's Dragon Skull from the sack he leaves behind. Kiting classes can solo him with patience, but a group is the intended route.

steps.title: Steal Maggoc's Treasure Chest (group)
steps.detail: Maggoc, Son of Gruul, wanders the southern reaches of Blade's Edge near 58.6, 60.8, south of the Circle of Blood toward Mok'Nathal Village. He is another five-player gronn; kill him and take Maggoc's Treasure Chest from the sack he drops. Can be done before or after Grulloc and Slaag.

steps.title: Bring Slaag's Standard from the Barrier Hills (group)
steps.detail: Slaag, Son of Gruul, lives in the Barrier Hills, the plateau above Shattrath City that is reachable only by flying (Terokkar Forest 20.2, 18.1, among the Gordunni ogres). Kill him with a group and loot Slaag's Standard. The Gordunni ogres here are also the targets of the Skyguard quest Threat from Above, so the two guides overlap nicely.

steps.title: Summon Vim'gol the Vile for his grimoire (5 players)
steps.detail: Once all three gronn quests are in, Mog'dorg offers Grim(oire) Business. Fly to Vim'gol's Circle in north-eastern Blade's Edge (77.5, 31.2), a ring of five small summoning circles. Five players must each stand in a circle at the same time to summon Vim'gol the Vile; while he casts Unholy Growth everyone must again stand in the circles to interrupt it. Kill him and loot Vim'gol's Vile Grimoire (item 32467).

steps.title: Destroy Skulloc Soulgrinder (group)
steps.detail: Take Vim'gol's Grimoire to the Soulgrinder, a great machine north-east of Bladespire Hold at about 60.7, 25.5. Reading the grimoire there calls Skulloc Soulgrinder, a huge gronn spirit, while ogre spirits channel at the surrounding stones. The fight is tuned for a full group of five. Loot Skulloc's Soul and carry it back to Mog'dorg, who then sends you to Ogri'la.

steps.title: Fly to Ogri'la and speak with Chu'a'lor
steps.detail: Ogre Heaven sends you west to Ogri'la, the ogre camp on the high plateau at the western edge of Blade's Edge between Forge Camp: Terror and Forge Camp: Wrath (28.8, 57.4). It can only be reached by flying mount or flight form. Chu'a'lor, the camp leader, takes the quest for 25 reputation. A Bladespire Supplicant near the Circle of Blood tower (55.8, 46.4) also offers the breadcrumb Speak with Mog'dorg (11022) if you lose track.

steps.title: Gather 5 Apexis Shards for The Crystals
steps.detail: Chu'a'lor asks for 5 Apexis Shards. They drop from almost every mob on the plateau (Apexis Flayers and the demons at the forge camps) and are also looted from the shard piles scattered across the plateau. The turn-in pays 250 Ogri'la reputation and unlocks every other Ogri'la and Skyguard Outpost quest in this guide.

steps.title: Win the Apexis Relic game once
steps.detail: Carry an Apexis Shard to any Apexis Relic on the plateau (the glowing pedestals surrounded by four coloured crystals) and start the memory game: repeat the sequence of colours the relic flashes, which grows each round. Four rounds of success grant the Apexis Vibrations buff that completes the quest; failing a round damages you. The first completion pays 250 Ogri'la and 250 Sha'tari Skyguard reputation and unlocks the daily version.

steps.title: Daily: The Relic's Emanation (350 Ogri'la)
steps.detail: The daily repeat of the relic game: use one Apexis Shard at a relic and win enough rounds to gain Apexis Emanations, then return to Chu'a'lor for 350 Ogri'la reputation. With a group of five, 35 shards at a relic instead summon a dragon or demon that drops an Apexis Crystal, the currency for Revered and Exalted rewards.
steps.detectedBy: Quest 11080 flagged complete today (daily flag resets); counts as part of the daily loop, not a one-time gate.

steps.title: Help Torkus: Our Boy Wants To Be A Skyguard Ranger
steps.questName: Our Boy Wants To Be A Skyguard Ranger
steps.detail: Torkus, beside Chu'a'lor, wants an Unstable Flask of the Beast. The flasks come from Shard-Hide Boars, Apexis Flayers and the plateau's other beasts, which drop them readily. Pays 250 Ogri'la reputation and is the prerequisite for The Skyguard Outpost, so it is not optional. Its follow-ups A Father's Duty (11061, Unstable Flask of the Sorcerer from the forge camp demons, 250) and A Fel Whip For Gahk (11079, Gahk at 28.5, 58.1, 500) are optional reputation.

steps.title: Report to Sky Commander Keller at the Skyguard Outpost
steps.detail: Chu'a'lor sends you to the Sha'tari Skyguard camp just north of Ogri'la (27.4, 52.7). Sky Commander Keller takes the quest for 10 Skyguard reputation and opens the Outpost's quests: Bombing Run from Sky Sergeant Vanderlip and, through Chu'a'lor, Guardian of the Monument.

steps.title: Kill an Apexis Guardian for Guardian of the Monument (group)
steps.detail: An Apexis Guardian, an elite crystal golem, stands at each of the Apexis monuments on the plateau (around 27.4, 68.6 and 31.8, 63.8, with another far north at 60.0, 9.5). Bring a group, kill one and loot the Apexis Guardian's Head. The turn-in pays 500 Ogri'la and 500 Sha'tari Skyguard reputation, the largest single one-time reward here.

steps.title: Bomb 15 Fel Cannonball Stacks (Bombing Run)
steps.detail: Sky Sergeant Vanderlip gives you Skyguard Bombs (item 32456). Fly over Forge Camp: Wrath (north of Ogri'la) or Forge Camp: Terror (south) and drop a bomb on 15 Fel Cannonball Stacks; the Legion's cannons fire at low fliers, so stay high and dive. Druids receive the flight-form version 11102 instead of 11010. Pays 500 Ogri'la and 500 Skyguard reputation and unlocks the daily Bomb Them Again! and Skyguard Khatie's Wrangle Some Aether Rays!.

steps.title: Daily: Bomb Them Again! (500 Ogri'la, 500 Skyguard)
steps.detail: Same run as Bombing Run, every day: 15 Fel Cannonball Stacks at either forge camp. It is the best-paying daily on the plateau for both factions at once, so it anchors the daily loop together with Wrangle More Aether Rays!, The Relic's Emanation and, from Honored, Banish More Demons.

steps.title: Wrangle Some Aether Rays!
steps.detail: Skyguard Khatie gives you a Wrangling Rope (item 32698). Fight the Aether Rays drifting over the plateau south and east of Ogri'la down to low health, then use the rope on them to leash a ray; lead it back to the Outpost. Five rays complete the quest for 350 Ogri'la and 350 Skyguard reputation, unlocking the daily Wrangle More Aether Rays! (11066, same rewards) and Keller's To Rule The Skies (11078, Dragon Teeth, 500 Skyguard).

steps.title: Daily: Wrangle More Aether Rays! (350 and 350)
steps.detail: Daily repeat: rope five more Aether Rays back to Khatie for 350 Ogri'la and 350 Sha'tari Skyguard reputation. Combine with Bomb Them Again! and The Relic's Emanation for about 1200 Ogri'la a day before Honored.

steps.title: Reach Friendly with Ogri'la
steps.detail: About two days of dailies from Neutral. Friendly unlocks Jho'nass's Crystal Healing and Mana Potions (50 shards each) and the tiny thank-you quest A Special Thank You (11091, Chu'a'lor to Jho'nass at 28.1, 58.7, 10 reputation).

steps.title: Reach Honored with Ogri'la
steps.detail: Roughly five more days of dailies. Honored adds the Ogre Brews at Jho'nass and, more importantly, unlocks Kronk's Banish the Demons chain, which adds a fourth daily to the loop. Honored with the Sha'tari Skyguard (earned in parallel) also opens the Skyguard flight between Blackwind Landing and Ogri'la.

steps.title: Banish the Demons at the forge camps (Honored)
steps.detail: Kronk, next to Chu'a'lor, only speaks to Honored allies. He gives a Banishing Crystal (item 32696): fight the demons at Forge Camp: Wrath or Forge Camp: Terror down to low health and use the crystal to banish them, 15 in all. Pays 350 Ogri'la reputation and unlocks the daily Banish More Demons. The side quest A Crystalforged Darkrune (11060, Gahk) belongs to the Shartuul's Transporter event and is optional.

steps.title: Daily: Banish More Demons (350 Ogri'la)
steps.detail: Daily repeat of the banishing run for 350 Ogri'la reputation. With all four dailies the plateau pays about 1550 Ogri'la a day, so Revered follows in about eight days and Exalted in about fourteen more.

steps.title: Reach Revered with Ogri'la
steps.detail: Revered opens Jho'nass's epic pieces: Apexis Cloak, Crystalforged Trinket, Ogri'la Aegis and Cerulean Crystal Rod, each for 1 Apexis Crystal and 50 Apexis Shards. Crystals come from the 35-shard group summons at any Apexis Relic.

steps.title: Reach Exalted with Ogri'la
steps.detail: Exalted sells the Crystalline Crossbow, Crystal Orb of Enlightenment, Shard-bound Bracers and Vortex Walking Boots for 4 Apexis Crystals and 100 Shards each, plus the Ogri'la Tabard for 10 shards. There is no mount; the Skyguard side of the plateau is where the nether rays come from.

Questie encodes the gates as requiredMinRep: Banish the Demons and A Crystalforged Darkrune need 1038 at 9000 (Honored); A Special Thank You needs 3000 (Friendly). The two Bombing Run ids are class-split (11010 for every class except druids, mask 479; 11102 for druids, mask 1024). Dailies carry Questie specialFlags 1 and questFlags bit 4096. guides.title: Sha'tari Skyguard: Skettis and Terokk
guides.summary: Yuula in Shattrath recruits fliers with Expert Riding to kill ogres in the Barrier Hills, then sends them to Blackwind Landing above Skettis in Terokkar Forest. Two dailies, Fires Over Skettis and Escape from Skettis, carry the reputation, while the Severin and Hazzik chain through the Talonpriests ends with summoning Terokk himself. Skyguard reputation also flows from the Ogri'la plateau quests, and Exalted buys the five nether ray mounts from Grella.
guides.unlocks: Sha'tari Skyguard reputation, the Skyguard flight between Blackwind Landing and Ogri'la at Honored, the Terokk summon, and at Exalted the Riding Nether Ray mounts and Nether Ray Fry pet from Grella.

phase.notes: Added in original patch 2.1; Anniversary Phase 2 (14 May 2026). Never removed. Every Skettis quest requires level 70 and Riding 225 (Questie requiredSkill 762 at 225); the Blackwind Landing camp sits on a cliff reachable only by air.

steps.title: Kill 20 Gordunni Ogres in the Barrier Hills
steps.detail: Yuula, the Skyguard Recruitment Officer beside the Shattrath flight master, offers Threat from Above only to level 70 characters with Expert Riding. Fly up to the Barrier Hills, the plateau directly above Shattrath, and kill any 20 Gordunni Ogres (Slaag, the gronn for the Ogri'la quest Even Gronn Have Standards, roams here too). Return for 250 Skyguard reputation.

steps.title: Deliver the Explosives Package to Blackwind Landing
steps.detail: Carry the Explosives Package (item 32848) to Sky Sergeant Doryn at Blackwind Landing, the Skyguard camp on the mountain ridge north of Skettis in south-eastern Terokkar Forest (64.5, 66.7). Pays 10 reputation and unlocks the two dailies and the camp's one-time quests.

steps.title: Daily: Fires Over Skettis (350 Skyguard)
steps.detail: Doryn gives Skyguard Blasting Charges (item 32406). Fly low over the arakkoa huts of Skettis and drop charges on the Monstrous Kaliri Eggs sitting on the rooftops; 20 eggs complete it. Monstrous Kaliri birds patrol the air and dismount anyone they catch, so bomb from above and keep moving. 350 reputation a day.

steps.title: Daily: Escape from Skettis (150 Skyguard)
steps.detail: A caged Skyguard Prisoner spawns at one of three cages in Skettis (68.4, 74.1; 75.1, 86.3; 61.0, 75.5). Free him and escort him on foot to the exit while arakkoa ambush along the path; stay mounted on the ground to keep pace. Report to Doryn for 150 reputation. Only one escort can be done per day.

steps.title: Feed the Hungry Nether Ray
steps.detail: Deesak hands you a Nether Ray Cage (item 32834). Place it in the woods just south of Blackwind Landing and kill Blackwind Warp Chasers next to the released Hungry Nether Ray so it can feed; ten meals complete it for 250 reputation. One-time only.

steps.title: Collect 6 Shadow Dust for Severin
steps.detail: Severin, the Skyguard Medic, wants 6 Shadow Dust from the arakkoa of Skettis. The dust drops from every arakkoa in the town. He turns it into an Elixir of Shadows, a 20-minute buff that lets you see the shadow arakkoa and the Talonpriests. Pays 250 reputation and unlocks Secrets of the Talonpriests plus the repeatable More Shadow Dust (11006, 6 dust for another elixir and 150 reputation).

steps.title: Slay Talonpriests Ishaal, Skizzik and Zellek
steps.detail: Drink an Elixir of Shadows in Skettis and hunt the three Talonpriests, who are invisible without it: Ishaal, Skizzik and Zellek each stand on a different hut platform in the town. Kill all three and return to Adaris for 250 reputation. Talonpriest Ishaal drops Ishaal's Almanac, which starts the next quest.

steps.title: Bring Ishaal's Almanac to Adaris
steps.detail: Ishaal's Almanac (item 32523) drops from Talonpriest Ishaal and starts a quest when read. Hand it to Sky Commander Adaris for 75 reputation; he cannot decipher it and sends you to Shattrath.
steps.detectedBy: Quest 11021 flagged complete (or item 32523 in bags means the step is in progress).

steps.title: Take the almanac to Rilak the Redeemed
steps.detail: Fly to Shattrath and find Rilak the Redeemed, the arakkoa in the north-western Lower City (52.5, 21.0). He reads the almanac and warns that Terokk's return is near. 75 reputation.

steps.title: Return to Adaris with news of Terokk
steps.detail: Carry Rilak's warning back to Sky Commander Adaris at Blackwind Landing for 75 reputation. Adaris passes you to Hazzik, the arakkoa defector standing in the camp.

steps.title: Fetch Hazzik's Package from eastern Skettis
steps.detail: Hazzik wants the package he left in his old dwelling in eastern Skettis. Fly to the eastern huts, loot Hazzik's Package from inside and bring it back. 75 reputation.

steps.title: Use the Shabby Arakkoa Disguise on Sahaak
steps.detail: Put on the Shabby Arakkoa Disguise (item 32741) in Skettis and walk, not fly, to the arakkoa Sahaak, who guards the Adversarial Bloodlines scroll on one of the central platforms. In disguise he will talk to you and hand over the Bloodlines; attacking or mounting breaks the disguise. 150 reputation.

steps.title: Summon and defeat the four descendants (group)
steps.detail: Collect Time-Lost Scrolls (item 32620) from the time-lost arakkoa, the shadowy ones visible only under the Elixir of Shadows. Ten scrolls used at the Skull Pile in the middle of a Skettis summoning circle call one of Terokk's adversaries' descendants: Akkarai, Karrog, Gezzarak the Huntress and Vakkiz the Windrager, each a group-worth elite. Kill all four and bring Akkarai's Talons, Karrog's Spine, Gezzarak's Claws and Vakkiz's Scale to Hazzik for 350 reputation. Tokens of the Descendants (11074, repeatable, 350) lets you repeat the summons for more reputation.
steps.detectedBy: Quest 11885 flagged complete (11072 is the retired duplicate id with no quest giver; accept either).

steps.title: Summon and defeat Terokk (group)
steps.detail: Hazzik prepares a Time-Lost Offering (item 32720). Use it at the Ancient Skull Pile on Terokk's Rest, the island summoning circle in Blackwind Lake at the centre of Skettis (66.2, 77.5), to call Terokk, a level 72 elite meant for five players. He casts Shadow Bolt Volley, marks a Chosen One, and at low health shields himself; drag him into the blue smoke where Skyguard bombers strike to shatter the shield before his Frenzy ends the fight. Loot includes the Time-Lost Figurine; the turn-in pays 1000 Skyguard reputation.

steps.title: Reach Honored with the Sha'tari Skyguard
steps.detail: Honored unlocks Skyguard Rations at Grella and the Skyguard flight path between Blackwind Landing and the Skyguard Outpost at Ogri'la. The Ogri'la plateau quests pay Skyguard reputation at the same time as Ogri'la reputation, so running both hubs is the fastest route.

steps.title: Reach Revered with the Sha'tari Skyguard
steps.detail: Revered opens the two cloaks at Grella: Skyguard's Drape (item 32539) and Skywitch's Drape (item 32538).

steps.title: Reach Exalted and buy a Riding Nether Ray
steps.detail: Grella, Skyguard Quartermaster at Blackwind Landing (64.3, 66.2), sells the Green (32314), Purple (32316), Red (32317), Silver (32318) and Blue (32319) Riding Nether Rays for 160 gold at Exalted (200 gold before the standing discount), the Nether Ray Fry pet (38628), the Skyguard Silver Cross (32770), Airman's Ribbon of Gallantry and the Skyguard Tabard. The rays are 280 percent mounts and need Artisan Riding.

guides.title: Netherwing: from Mordenai to a Nether Drake
guides.summary: Mordenai at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley starts a nine-quest chain that frees Karynaku from Dragonmaw Fortress and lifts you from Hated to Neutral with the Netherwing in one turn-in. Artisan Riding then lets you swear the Blood Oath, take the Dragonmaw Illusion and work undercover at Dragonmaw Base Camp on Netherwing Ledge, where each standing unlocks more one-time quests and dailies. Exalted ends with Illidan himself and a free Netherwing drake from Barthamus in Shattrath.
guides.unlocks: Netherwing reputation to Exalted, one free Netherwing drake (280 percent flying mount) from the Lower City drakes and the right to buy the other five from Drake Dealer Hurlunk.

phase.notes: Added in original patch 2.1 but on TBC Classic and Anniversary realms it came with Phase 3 (Black Temple and Hyjal, 27 August 2026). Never removed. Level 70 throughout; the Hated-to-Neutral chain needs only a flying mount to reach Netherwing Ledge, but Blood Oath of the Netherwing and Enter the Taskmaster require Riding 300 (Artisan). Kill Them All! also requires City of Light from the Shattrath intro.

steps.title: Feed 8 Mature Netherwing Drakes
steps.detail: Mordenai stands among the drakes at Netherwing Fields, east of Wildhammer Stronghold (59.2, 58.7). Kill Rocknail Flayers nearby for 8 Rocknail Flayer Carcasses (item 31372) and 5 Giblets (item 31373), then feed the carcasses to Mature Netherwing Drakes in the fields. Eight fed drakes finish the quest and start the chain toward Neltharaku.

steps.title: Seek Out Neltharaku above the fields
steps.detail: Mordenai gives you a means to call Neltharaku, patron of the Netherwing flight, who circles high above Netherwing Fields near 61.3, 60.0. Use it in the fields and he descends to speak. Then listen to Neltharaku's Tale (10814), a short talk-only quest that must be completed before he gives work.

steps.title: Listen to Neltharaku's Tale
steps.detail: Accept the tale and let Neltharaku finish his story about the Dragonmaw enslaving his children; the credit The Tale of Neltharaku appears when he is done. Turn it in on the spot.

steps.title: Slay 15 Dragonmaw Orcs at Dragonmaw Fortress
steps.detail: Dragonmaw Fortress is the fel orc stronghold on the eastern cliffs of Shadowmoon Valley around 69, 60. Any Dragonmaw orc there counts; the Subjugators and Wyrmcallers on the lower terraces are the easiest 15. Return to Neltharaku.

steps.title: Collect 12 Nethervine Crystals on Netherwing Ledge
steps.detail: Netherwing Ledge is the floating island off the south-eastern coast of Shadowmoon Valley and can only be reached by flying. Nethervine Crystals grow all over the ledge as small purple crystal nodes; gather 12 while avoiding the hostile Dragonmaw patrols, who are not yet friendly to you.

steps.title: Free 5 Enslaved Netherwing Drakes
steps.detail: Neltharaku gives you an Enchanted Nethervine Crystal (item 31652). Use it on the Enslaved Netherwing Drakes chained around Dragonmaw Fortress; each freed drake flies off and some fight their captors on the way. Five freed drakes complete the quest.

steps.title: Find Karynaku inside Dragonmaw Fortress
steps.detail: Karynaku, Neltharaku's mate, is chained in the open courtyard of Dragonmaw Fortress at 69.9, 61.4, guarded by Zuluhed the Whacked and his retinue. Fly in and speak to her; she can be reached without fighting if you land beside her.

steps.title: Kill Zuluhed the Whacked and free Karynaku (group)
steps.detail: Zuluhed the Whacked, Chieftain of the Dragonmaw, stands on the platform above Karynaku at 71.0, 62.2 with Dragonmaw guards and will summon Illidari help; he is a five-player elite. Kill him, loot Zuluhed's Key (item 31664) and use it on Zuluhed's Chains beside Karynaku to free her. Humans receive the id 10872 instead of 10866 (and 10871 instead of 10870 for the next step); both versions are identical.

steps.title: Return to Mordenai as Ally of the Netherwing
steps.detail: Karynaku sends you back to Mordenai. The turn-in grants 42000 Netherwing reputation at once, carrying you from the bottom of Hated to Neutral (a reputation buff can land you in Friendly). This is the end of the one-time chain; everything after it is gated by Riding 300 and your standing.

steps.title: Have Artisan Riding (300) before the Blood Oath
steps.detail: Blood Oath of the Netherwing and Enter the Taskmaster both carry a Riding 300 requirement in the quest data; Mordenai will not offer the oath without it. See the FLYING_EPIC guide for trainers and costs.

steps.title: Swear the Blood Oath of the Netherwing
steps.detail: With Neutral standing and Artisan Riding, Mordenai offers the oath. Accepting and turning it in on the spot grants the Dragonmaw Illusion, a disguise that makes you look like a fel orc whenever you are on Netherwing Ledge or in Dragonmaw Fortress, so the Dragonmaw there treat you as one of their own (Dragonmaw Ascendants, Skybreakers and Transporters excepted). Your flying mount also appears as a nether drake there.

steps.title: Deliver the Illidari Service Papers to Overlord Mor'ghor
steps.detail: Fly to Dragonmaw Base Camp on the western side of Netherwing Ledge (66.3, 85.6) and present the Illidari Service Papers (item 32469) to Overlord Mor'ghor, who runs the camp for Illidan. 250 reputation. He hands you to the Taskmaster.

steps.title: Report to Taskmaster Varkule Dragonbreath
steps.detail: Taskmaster Varkule stands a few steps from Mor'ghor. Speaking with him unlocks the Neutral dailies: Netherwing Crystals and the gathering daily for your profession. During A Job Unfinished... (11041, started from a Partially Digested Hand found on Overmine Flayers, 250) you also slay Barash the Den Mother in the mine.

steps.title: Meet Yarzill the Merc, your friend on the inside
steps.detail: Yarzill, a goblin at the camp who is secretly a Netherwing drake in disguise, reveals himself after In Service of the Illidari. Turning in his quest opens A Slow Death, The Not-So-Friendly Skies..., The Great Netherwing Egg Hunt and, at Friendly, Rise, Overseer!.

steps.title: Daily loop at Neutral: Netherwing Crystals and friends
steps.detail: From Neutral the dailies are: Netherwing Crystals (11015, 30 crystals from mobs and nodes on the ledge, 250); one gathering daily matched to your profession at 350 skill, Nethercite Ore (11018, Mining), Netherdust Pollen (11017, Herbalism) or Nethermine Flayer Hide (11016, Skinning), 250 each; Yarzill's A Slow Death (11020, poison 12 Dragonmaw Peon Camps with Yarzill's Mutton and Fel Glands from the flayers, 250); and The Not-So-Friendly Skies... (11035, shoot down Dragonmaw Transporters with the flare gun and loot 10 Netherwing Relics, 250). Each is 250 reputation a day.

steps.title: Find a Netherwing Egg and keep handing them in
steps.detail: Netherwing Eggs (item 32506) spawn randomly on the ledge, in the Netherwing Mines and in Dragonmaw Fortress, and occasionally drop from mobs or gathering nodes. The first egg completes The Great Netherwing Egg Hunt for 350 reputation; after that Accepting All Eggs (11050) takes every further egg for 250 each with no daily limit, which is the fastest way to shorten the grind.

steps.title: Reach Friendly with the Netherwing
steps.detail: About one day of dailies after the chain. Friendly unlocks Rise, Overseer!, the Netherwing Mines dailies and the Booterang daily, lifting the daily income to roughly 1800 a day.

steps.title: Rise, Overseer! (Friendly)
steps.detail: At Friendly the Taskmaster promotes you: speak with Overlord Mor'ghor for 250 reputation and the Overseer's Badge, a trinket that summons a Dragonmaw peon to fight for you in Shadowmoon Valley. The promotion opens Chief Overseer Mudlump's quests and The Netherwing Mines.

steps.title: Overseeing and You, then the daily Booterang
steps.questName: Overseeing and You: Making the Right Choices

steps.title: The Netherwing Mines and its dailies

(11076, 15 Nethermine Cargo crates lying in the mine tunnels) and Dragons are the Least of Our Problems (11077, 15 Nethermine Flayers and 5 Nethermine Ravagers inside the mine). steps.title: Reach Honored with the Netherwing
steps.detail: Honored (around day four) promotes you to Captain and unlocks Disrupting the Twilight Portal, the Soul Cannon chain and the Dragonmaw Races.

steps.title: Stand Tall, Captain! (Honored)
steps.detail: Speak with Mor'ghor for 500 reputation and the Captain's Badge, whose peon follows you in every zone. Opens Disrupting the Twilight Portal, Illidari Lord Balthas's Soul Cannon quests and Ja'y Nosliw's Earning Your Wings....

steps.title: Daily: Disrupting the Twilight Portal (500)
steps.detail: Kill 20 Deathshadow Agents, the Twilight's Hammer cultists around the portal on the eastern end of Netherwing Ledge. They die quickly and the quest pays 500 a day, the best daily on the ledge.

steps.title: Build the Soul Cannon and subdue Reth'hedron
steps.detail: Balthas wants 2 Felsteel Bars, an Adamantite Frame, a Khorium Power Core and a Flawless Arcane Essence (crafted or auction-house items) for 500 reputation. He then gives the Soul Cannon (item 32825) for Subdue the Subduer (11090, 500): fly to the far western shore of Nagrand (10.1, 41.2), fight Reth'hedron the Subduer, a huge elite, and fire the cannon at him when he is low to banish him. He hits hard; bring help or kite.

steps.title: Win the six Dragonmaw Races
steps.detail: Ja'y Nosliw, the Skybreaker General, challenges you to six flying races against his riders, who stand in a line at about 65.2, 85 and each hand out their race: The Ballad of Oldie McOld (11064, 350), Trope the Filth-Belcher (11067, 350), Corlok the Vet (11068, 500), Wing Commander Ichman (11069, 500), Wing Commander Mulverick (11070, 500) and Captain Skyshatter (11071, 1000). Follow the racer closely as he flies a course over Shadowmoon Valley while dropping bombs and fire on you; falling too far behind fails the race. Each race must be won in order and reported to Ja'y. Together they pay 3200 reputation.

steps.title: Hail, Commander! (Revered)

steps.title: Reach Exalted with the Netherwing
steps.detail: Exalted, usually two weeks after the chain if every daily is done (fewer with eggs), unlocks Bow to the Highlord. Drake Dealer Hurlunk (23489, at the camp 65.6, 85.9) also opens his stock of all six Reins of the Netherwing Drake.

steps.title: Bow to the Highlord and meet Illidan

Lord Illidan Stormrage pays 1000 reputation and sends you to Barthamus (23433) on the ridge above Shattrath's Lower City (66.6, 16.4).

guides.title: Shattered Sun Offensive: Isle of Quel'Danas
guides.summary: The Isle of Quel'Danas opens in the final phase with a short introduction from your Shattrath faction that leads to Exarch Larethor at the Shattered Sun Staging Area. The realm then reclaims Sun's Reach together: daily quests advance server-wide objectives from the Sanctum to the Armory, the Shattrath portal, the Harbor, the anvil, the Alchemy Lab and the Monument, each unlocking new dailies and vendors. Reputation comes from the dailies, the Outland dailies in Shattrath and the Throne of Kil'jaeden, and Magisters' Terrace; Exalted ends with the title of the Shattered Sun.

On Anniversary realms it is scheduled for Phase 5 (Fury of the Sunwell), listed as Autumn 2026 with no date yet, so nothing in this guide is live as of 24 October 2026. The stage order is fixed but a realm's stage depends on realm-wide daily completions, so the addon should detect the stage from which quest ids are offered or completed rather than from a calendar.

(11550, to Archmage Ne'thul, 25) as a second signpost.

The Lower City dailies Wanted: The Signet Ring of Prince Kael'thas (11499, heroic only, 350) and Wanted: Sisters of Torment (11500, 250) then pay Shattered Sun and Lower City reputation, and a heroic clear is worth about 2800 reputation.

Two progress dailies advance it: Erratic Behavior (11524, Vindicator Xayann: place Attuned Crystal Cores in 5 defeated Erratic Sentries, 150) and The Sanctum Wards (11496, Captain Theris Dawnhearth at 47.5, 30.6: 4 Mana Remnants from Wretched Fiends and Devourers, then energize a Crystal Ward, 150). steps.title: Reach Friendly with the Shattered Sun Offensive
steps.detail: Everyone starts Neutral. Friendly unlocks Naaru Rations at Eldara Dawnrunner, the quartermaster near the staging area (47.2, 30.8).

steps.title: Reach Honored with the Shattered Sun Offensive
steps.detail: Honored unlocks the enchanting formulas (Void Shatter, Enchant Chest - Defense) and the first jewelcrafting designs at Eldara Dawnrunner.

steps.title: Reach Revered with the Shattered Sun Offensive
steps.detail: Revered opens the weapon list (Legionfoe, Seeker's Gavel, Archmage's Guile, Truestrike Crossbow, K'iru's Presage, Bombardier's Blade, The Sunbreaker, Inuuro's Blade) and the meta-gem and figurine designs.

steps.title: Reach Exalted with the Shattered Sun Offensive
steps.detail: Exalted sells the Sunward Crest and Dawnforged Defender shields, the Shattered Sun Pendants of Acumen, Might, Resolve and Restoration, the four Alchemist Stone recipes and the Tabard of the Shattered Sun (item 35221, 1 gold). About 20 dailies a day plus heroic Magisters' Terrace make this a two to three week grind.

steps.title: Donate 1000 gold for the title of the Shattered Sun
steps.detail: At Exalted, Anchorite Kairthos at Sun's Reach Harbor offers A Magnanimous Benefactor: donate 1000 gold to Anchorite Ayuri's cause. The quest text itself promises the title of the Shattered Sun on completion, plus a final 500 reputation. It is one-time and the title is the only way to earn it.
